verdicts.verify_by: cp reviews/pr/6xxx/6425-gnokey-gas-price/1-6b7e7bdfc/tests/b2-lines-reach-catalog-partial-drops-measure_test.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/zz_b2_partial_drops_measure_test.go && go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestB2PartialEmptyDropsMeasure -v -count=1: expect the last measure kept, observe {Max:0 Calls:0} fresh for 5m0s
verdicts.tldr: a slow indexer's empty ErrPartial read replaces the last gas measure with nothing for 5 minutes
verdicts.details: read() treats ErrPartial as success (gas_use.go:122) even with zero rows, and indexer.recent returns exactly that when the 10 s gasUseTimeout leaves under minWindowBudget (900 ms) after three 3.2 s bands (queries.go:364 break, then partial() at 356-357). A package whose recent calls sit only in the fourth band (146k to 1.17M blocks back) is measured by a fast read and then wiped by a slow one, so for gasUseTTL the page shows no gas use and NewTxGas falls back to TxGasWanted: the fast-mode fee is lost and a function measured above the default gets a command that fails its simulation. The comment at 125-127 promises the opposite, and a hard error on the same read keeps the measure; the trigger is narrow (slow-but-answering indexer, calls only in the deepest band) and self-heals after 5 min, and gas_use.go is new in this PR. Fix: on ErrPartial with no rows for the package, keep last.uses as the error branch does (or store with gasUseRetry), and store the new map only when it has rows or err == nil.
verdicts.evidence: Head, finder artifact rerun: 'RecentByPackage: 0 rows, err=searched the most recent blocks only, took 9.6s' / 'after a slow read: Deposit = {Max:0 Calls:0}, entry fresh=true, expires in 5m0s' / FAIL. Head, judge artifact with a truthful indexer (rows only in the band gt: 8830000, every band 3.2 s on the second read): 'fast read: Deposit = {Max:1400000 Calls:1}' then 'slow read: Deposit = {Max:0 Calls:0}, fresh=true' / FAIL (9.60s). Base: gas_use.go does not exist at 5e9668dab, no gas-use cache to compare.
